lemmas.primary_translation: may you use it in good health

definitions.text: uttrykk for at en håper noen får være sunne og friske så lenge de bruker noe (sagt når en gir noe til bruk eller noen har fått noe nytt)
definitions.translation: an expression of hope that someone will remain healthy and well for as long as they use something (said when giving something for use or when someone has received something new) (lit. wear or use it with health)
